title: To-do survives a page reload
summary: After adding a to-do and reloading the page, the to-do is still listed because it is saved in localStorage (Kane issue 252 reported the reload being done as a Ctrl+R key press).
what_differs: The broken page keeps to-dos only in memory and never reads them back, so a real reload clears the list.
steps: Type "pay rent" into the "New to-do" box and press Enter. Reload the page.

wordings.text: Verify the to-do list shows "pay rent".
Verify the exact visible text of the to-do list includes "pay rent" after the page has been reloaded.
